subject: Post-call: Model fit / regression concerns after v2.x rollout
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap and next steps — model fit/eval follow-up

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Observed goal: improve outbound email classification & intent routing accuracy (reduce false positives in auto-forwarding).
- Current setup: using open-llm/ultra-lite v2.1.0 behind Redwood inference with default quantization profile.
- Your main concern: recent rollout appears correlated with a rise in incorrect classifications on a subset of prompts (sales leads).

Action items I proposed on the call:
1) You to send representative failure examples and a short benchmark set (you mentioned ~50 examples).
2) We will run a quick differential eval vs v2.0 (pin) and v2.1.0 to get delta metrics and sample diffs.
3) If there is a regression, we can pin your route to v2.0 and open a rollback for broader customers while we investigate.

I copied Rishi (runtime) and Neha (solutions) to help own the rollout/rollback path and quick evals. Please send the examples when ready — a plain text file or CSV is fine.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: acme_example_prompt_set.txt (text/plain)]

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:46:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and next steps — model fit/eval follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Attaching the set we pulled together this morning. Two quick notes:

- We started seeing the spike right after you rolled v2.1.0 on Tuesday (May 12) — classification for the "request-demo" intent dropped from 93% to ~78% on our internal test harness.
- I attached 12 failing examples (acme_examples_v2_regressions.txt) and a small CSV snapshot of the benchmark run (acme_benchmark_v2.csv). The examples include model outputs that truncate or prioritize the wrong entity.

Can you confirm whether v2.1.0 changed any decoding defaults or prompt templates on your side? We didn't change our integration. This is blocking our beta traffic.

- Tom
CTO, Acme AI
Tom.Alvarez@acme.ai | +1 (617) 555-0987

[Attachment: acme_examples_v2_regressions.txt (text/plain)]
[Attachment: acme_benchmark_v2.csv (text/csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:05:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and next steps — model fit/eval follow-up

Tom —

Really appreciate the quick samples, this is exactly what we need. First-pass thoughts before Rishi dives into infra-level diffs:

- We don't intentionally change prompt templates on customer routes during minor model version bumps; model artifact changes and kernel selection can affect outputs.
- I kicked off an A/B differential run: v2.0 (your pinned baseline) vs v2.1.0 across your sample set. Preliminary metrics are linked below.

Quick links / resources:
- Benchmark dashboard: https://redwood.app/benchmarks/acme-ai-model-fit-2026 (contains per-example diffs and per-token traces)
- Prompt set (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-acme-eval

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
1) Rishi: run a full diff and surface any changed decoding params or kernel fallbacks (ETA: 4 hours).
2) If a regression is confirmed, we will:
   a) Pin your production route to v2.0 immediately (safety rollback).
   b) Open a targeted rollback for the rollout that moved to v2.1.0.
   c) Share a regression report with samples and a suggested fix (model tweak, prompt adjustment, or runtime config).
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up call today to review findings and agree on roll-forward / rollback.

Rishi — can you confirm the ETA and whether we can pin the route without downtime?

Thanks,
Marissa

[HubSpot: hs-12345]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and next steps — model fit/eval follow-up

On Wed, May 20, 2026 at 09:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Rishi — can you confirm the ETA and whether we can pin the route without downtime?

We can. Quick tech notes / plan:

- ETA: full diff & per-example KV traces in ~3 hours. I will post the job results to the benchmark dashboard link Marissa shared.
- Pinning: we support per-route model pinning; it is a config change (no infra restart). Pin to open-llm/ultra-lite v2.0 and optionally set decoding params (top_p / temperature) to match your baseline. This is reversible and takes effect within ~30s per route.
- Canary/rollback plan: we should canary the rollback for 10% of traffic for 1 hour, monitor per-intent precision/recall + end-to-end latency. If metrics return to baseline, we roll to 100%.
- Root cause checklist I'll run: model artifact diffs (tokenizer / vocab changes), decoding defaults changed upstream, runtime kernel fallbacks that affect conditioned generation, and prompt normalization differences.

I'll update in-thread with the diff link and recommended config. If we confirm regression, Marissa, will you coordinate a 30-min meeting at 10:00 AM PT?

-rishi
Head of Runtime | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rishi_diff_job_20260520.log (text/plain)]

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.ai>, Legal Team <contracts@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and next steps — model fit/eval follow-up

Thanks everyone — that plan sounds good. We can be available for the 10:00 AM PT slot.

One ask from our side: if pinning is the short-term mitigation, can you include a short note we can share with our Product team explaining why the regression happened (high level) and expected ETA for a permanent fix? Legal also asked for the benchmark report for our records.

Appreciate the fast support here.

—Sara
